Title: NCCM onboarding validates connectivity from the assigned collector

Step Action: Login as admin; discover a branch device through a branch Collector so it is in Inventory with that Collector assigned, and confirm polling works
Step Expected: Device is monitored successfully through its Collector

Step Action: Onboard that device for NCCM from the Inventory screen
Step Expected: Connectivity validation runs from the assigned Collector and succeeds. Today it runs from the Main/Master server and fails with Ping/Port errors — the reported defect

Title: Branch device unreachable from master still onboards for NCCM

Step Action: Set up a device reachable from its branch Collector but NOT from the Main/Master server
Step Expected: Device polls fine via the Collector

Step Action: Onboard it for NCCM
Step Expected: Onboarding completes — reachability from the master is not required when a Collector is assigned

Title: Ping check is executed by the assigned collector, not the master

Step Action: Onboard a Collector-assigned device for NCCM while watching where the ping originates
Step Expected: Validation runs

Step Action: Inspect the source of the ping
Step Expected: The ping check executes on the assigned Collector. The discovery engine's ping-check routine must be dispatched to the Collector rather than run locally on the master

Title: Port check is executed by the assigned collector, not the master

Step Action: Onboard a Collector-assigned device for NCCM whose SSH/Telnet port is reachable only from the Collector
Step Expected: Validation runs

Step Action: Inspect the source of the port check
Step Expected: The port check executes on the assigned Collector and reports the port open

Title: Device with no collector assigned still validates from the master

Step Action: Onboard a device that has no specific Collector assigned (master-polled)
Step Expected: Validation runs

Step Action: Inspect the outcome
Step Expected: Validation runs from the Main/Master server exactly as before — the change must not break the default topology

Title: Genuine unreachability from the collector still fails clearly

Step Action: Assign a Collector to a device, then make the device unreachable from that Collector too
Step Expected: Device is down from the Collector

Step Action: Onboard it for NCCM
Step Expected: Onboarding fails with a Ping/Port connectivity error that names the Collector it was attempted from — the fix must not mask real failures

Title: Error message identifies which collector performed the check

Step Action: Trigger a failing NCCM connectivity validation on a Collector-assigned device
Step Expected: Validation fails

Step Action: Read the error
Step Expected: It states the Collector used, so an operator can tell a wrong-collector problem from a genuine unreachability

Step Action: Note the configured ping-check timeout and packet count, then onboard a device that drops ICMP
Step Expected: Validation runs

Step Action: Measure the failure
Step Expected: It fails after the configured timeout using the configured packet count — the same configuration values as the existing discovery ping check, applied on the Collector

Title: Validation is skipped when ping check is not required

Step Action: Onboard a device of a type/profile where ping check is not required
Step Expected: Onboarding proceeds

Step Action: Inspect the flow
Step Expected: The ping check is skipped per the existing require-check logic rather than being forced and failing

Title: Multiple branches each validate through their own collector

Step Action: Assign Collector A to a device in branch A and Collector B to a device in branch B
Step Expected: Both poll successfully

Step Action: Onboard both for NCCM
Step Expected: Each validates from its own Collector; neither is validated from the other branch's Collector or from the master

Step Action: Onboard a device for NCCM via Collector A, then reassign it to Collector B
Step Expected: Reassignment saved

Step Action: Re-run NCCM connectivity validation
Step Expected: The check now runs from Collector B without needing to re-onboard the device

Title: Collector down during onboarding produces a clear error

Step Action: Stop the assigned Collector, then onboard its device for NCCM
Step Expected: Validation is attempted

Step Action: Read the error
Step Expected: It reports that the assigned Collector is unavailable rather than silently falling back to the master or hanging indefinitely

Title: No silent fallback to the master when the collector check fails

Step Action: Make a device reachable from the master but not from its assigned Collector, then onboard it
Step Expected: Validation runs

Step Action: Inspect the outcome
Step Expected: Validation fails on the Collector result and does not quietly retry from the master — a silent fallback would reintroduce the bug in reverse and mislead the operator
